key_highlights: ASX closed the week higher supported by banking gains and a Fed rate pause, despite retail sector drag.
RBA signals potential rate hikes as inflationary pressures persist, increasing strain on highly leveraged consumers.
Australian housing market faces steep headwinds with Sydney home values down 10% in 237 days and weak auction clearance rates.
Supermarket dynamics diverge sharply as Coles loses market share and billions in value to rival Woolworths.
Energy transition uncertainties escalate amid east coast gas policy risks and renewable project delays.

sectors.trend: Banking shares rallied to lift the broader index following US Fed rate pauses, though domestic mortgage risks loom.
sectors.implications: Major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX) offer dividend stability but face rising credit risk from housing stress and RBA rate hikes.

sectors.trend: Intense competitive pressure sees Coles lose significant ground to Woolworths as budget-conscious shoppers pivot.
sectors.implications: Favor Woolworths (WOW.AX) over Coles (COL.AX); elevated living costs continue to pressure discretionary retail spending.

sectors.trend: Junior exploration stocks post strong regional hits in precious metals and lithium, while bulk iron ore sentiment remains volatile.
sectors.implications: Select opportunities in high-grade exploration; major miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) remain tied to global commodity demand cycles.

sectors.trend: Domestic gas policy uncertainty and infrastructure hurdles compound ongoing global crude supply frictions.
sectors.implications: Regulatory intervention risks compress valuations for east coast gas producers (WDS.AX, ORG.AX), while long-term supply tightness underpins pricing.

sectors.trend: Residential property correction accelerates with steep price falls across Sydney and Melbourne alongside depressed auction activity.
sectors.implications: Negative backdrop for residential developers (MGR.AX, SGP.AX); commercial REITs remain pressured by elevated debt service costs.

sectors.trend: Record digital asset hack and corporate regulatory scrutiny over failed floats highlight heightened governance and security risks.
sectors.implications: Investors demand higher risk premiums for speculative tech; micro-investing platforms (RZI.AX) demonstrate resilient retail engagement.

key_themes: Monetary policy divergence between the US Fed and hawkish RBA
Cost-of-living squeeze accelerating supermarket market share shifts
Accelerating residential property downturn dampening consumer wealth
Regulatory interventions and execution roadblocks in energy transition

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight interest-rate-sensitive consumer discretionary and REITs; prioritize high-quality balance sheets.
Limit exposure to domestic residential developers and monitor mortgage delinquency trends across major banks.
Focus on diversified energy producers with substantial offshore LNG export revenue rather than purely domestic supply.
Avoid unhedged crypto asset exposure; ensure portfolio fintech holdings have rigorous institutional custody and compliance.

opportunities.rationale: Woolworths is capturing grocery market share while Coles faces valuation downgrades and operational execution hurdles.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to major commercial banks
opportunities.rationale: Australian banks benefit from elevated net interest margins and institutional inflows following Fed rate stability.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate quality precious metals and critical mineral producers
opportunities.rationale: Exploration success and gold/silver strength provide defensive hedges against domestic macroeconomic deterioration.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge ASX equity exposure via index derivatives and bond insurance
defensive_moves.rationale: Looming RBA rate hike risks and weak consumer fundamentals threaten broader index multiples.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to residential REITs and discretionary retailers
defensive_moves.rationale: Plunging property prices in Sydney and Melbourne combined with weak auction clearances indicate prolonged earnings headwinds.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound and defensive. While banking sector resilience supports the ASX 200, RBA rate hike risks and consumer retail softness cap near-term multiple expansion.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural macro headwinds from falling residential property values and high household debt will slow domestic consumption, favoring resource exporters and robust dividend payers.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy meeting and cash rate decision
Australian quarterly CPI and labor market employment prints
Federal government policy announcements on east coast domestic gas reservation
US Federal Reserve monetary policy trajectory and AUD/USD movement
watch_list: CoreLogic 5-capital city home value index and weekend auction clearance rates
RBA cash rate futures and Australian 3-year/10-year government bond yields
Iron ore benchmark prices (62% Fe CFR China) and thermal/coking coal pricing
Supermarket weekly scanner data and discretionary retail sales figures
